title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures
description: Barbie Dreamhouse Adventures Go Team Roberts: Season 4-5Barbie, her sisters, friends and neighbour Ken share vlogs filmed in her Dreamhouse.

episodes.title: S3-E2All Dogs Go to the Beach
S5-E3Barbie, Brownies and Bears, Oh My!
S5-E9The Curse of the Miner's Ghost

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 1x1
episodes_data.description: Barbie's "Best Day Ever" starts out great... until the dreamhouse starts acting up. Could their new home be cursed?

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 1x2
episodes_data.description: Barbie and her friends plan a Birthday surprise for Chelsea by giving her clubhouse a makeover. But their missions take a smelly detour.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 1x3
episodes_data.description: Barbie puts her skills to the test when she competes on an extreme baking show against a reigning champ who loves to win and hates to lose.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 1x4
episodes_data.description: The Roberts clan gets back to basics when Dad challenges them to a weekend of pioneer living. And the catch? It's all happening in their own backyard

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 1x5
episodes_data.description: When Skipper snags her first babysitting job, an overprotective Barbie goes overboard trying to make sure everything runs smoothly.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 1x6
episodes_data.description: Barbie and her friends take a road trip to hear Daisy drop the beat at a major music festival. But Daisy seems to keep finding reasons to stall along the way.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 1x7
episodes_data.description: Skipper steps in to handle her parents' 20th anniversary party when Barbie gets a once-in-a-lifetime invitation to attend Robot Con.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 1x8
episodes_data.description: With their parents away for the night, Barbie, Skipper, and Stacie recruit Ken for an elaborate plan to bring Chelsea's imaginary "Roof Fairy" to life.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 2x1
episodes_data.description: Barbie feels like she's getting too old for her father-daughter tradition, so she passes it down to Chelsea. But is she really ready to let it go?

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 2x2
episodes_data.description: Thinking about the future prompts Barbie to have a dream where anything's possible—and everything's really, really weird.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 2x3
episodes_data.description: When Barbie discovers Duchess the horse is going to be sold, she and Stacie come up with a plan to keep her around.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 2x4
episodes_data.description: Instead of reading a book at bedtime, Chelsea tells her family about their puppies' secret—and surprisingly dangerous—lives.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 2x5
episodes_data.description: While trying out a new escape room with their friends, Barbie and Ken get separated from the group and wind up on an adventure of their own.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 2x6
episodes_data.description: Chelsea's campaign to raise money for puppy literacy continues with a miniature golf tournament that involves the whole neighborhood.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 2x7
episodes_data.description: From dancing to baking, the unstoppable Barbie Roberts can do anything ... except ask for help when she needs it most.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 2x8
episodes_data.description: Fate turns the tide on Trey and Barbie when they compete for the best stop on the beach. Back at the Dreamhouse, Stacie tries to set a world record.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 2x9
episodes_data.description: Renee's desperate to impress her relatives in China, but Barbie doesn't have the heart to tell her "talents" need an awful lot of work.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 3x1
episodes_data.description: Barbie and her friends get swept up in the pursuit of internet popularity after a goofy vlog post unintentionally goes viral and they find being famous isn't as great as it seems.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 3x2
episodes_data.description: When dogs get banned from the beach, Barbie and Nikki decide to fight City Hall; victory looks certain until Poppy Reardon joins the race and fights anything but fair.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 3x3
episodes_data.description: Barbie and Daisy take a trip to Barbie's Wisconsin hometown, where it's up to Barbie to save her beloved Aunt Adele's struggling inn.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 3x4
episodes_data.description: When Stacie and Skipper get into a fight, Barbie offers to switch rooms with them; eventually, all of the Roberts sisters learn no roommate is perfect.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 3x5
episodes_data.description: Instead of enjoying a relaxing spa weekend with their friends, Ken and Barbie end up trying to keep the owner's grandson out of trouble.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 3x6
episodes_data.description: Trey injures himself on the Roberts' property, so the family is extra nice to him. But Barbie and her sisters fear Trey might be up to something.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 3x7
episodes_data.description: Barbie and her friends try to wow Nikki's fashion idol at a mermaid convention, but things take a fishy turn when Barbie's sisters become suspects in a mystery.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 3x8
episodes_data.description: With her sisters suspected in a string of thefts due to a misunderstanding, Barbie works to clear their names and find the real thief, as well as help Nikki impress her idol.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 3x9
episodes_data.description: The Roberts family could be evicted from their Dreamhouse unless Barbie can figure out who is behind Malibu's sudden flea infestation.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x1
episodes_data.description: George decides to take the family on holiday to Costa Rica where he will be filming a whale documentary, while Barbie and friends land summer jobs at a water park in Malibu.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x2
episodes_data.description: After her boss quits, Barbie gets promoted with new responsibilities. Meanwhile, Skipper and Stacie join Chelsea on a quest to find a missing mermaid, but end up getting lost.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x3
episodes_data.description: Barbie's friends struggle to adjust to her becoming their boss at Oceans Extreme. In Costa Rica, Stacie, Skipper and Chelsea close in on the missing mermaid.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x4
episodes_data.description: Barbie and her friends create a plan to stop smugglers and save a baby whale. As a reward, Barbie gets a ticket to Costa Rica, where she joins her family to see the whales arrive!

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x5
episodes_data.description: On her first day back at school, Barbie learns that Golden Beach High's newest student is none other than Tammy, her opponent from the baking competition show.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x6
episodes_data.description: Barbie offers to help Renee build her school basketball team by trying out, but she soon realises that she is not as great as she thought she would be.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x7
episodes_data.description: Ken asks Barbie to help him invite Harriet to a school dance. Despite her mixed feelings, Barbie agrees to do it, because what are friends for?

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x8
episodes_data.description: When Margaret hesitates to take a promotion at her job, Barbie and her sisters work together to prove to their mother that they can handle extra responsibilities.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x9
episodes_data.description: Skipper takes Barbie's jacket without permission and ends up misplacing it. The two sisters race around town trying to get the jacket back, but are always one step behind.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x10
episodes_data.description: Barbie tries to help Skipper adjust to high school by inviting her to join their lunch table. When Skipper bonds with her friends, Barbie unexpectedly feels left out.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x11
episodes_data.description: The Roberts family are driven to enter Malibu's annual Family of the Year contest, competing against the family that has won every year for the past decade, the Reardons.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x12
episodes_data.description: Barbie and Skipper decide to work together on their school community service project at the Water Park, but the two clash when Skipper doesn't put in an equal amount of effort.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 4x13
episodes_data.description: The Roberts host their neighbours at the Dreamhouse when an earthquake causes a power cut. Meanwhile, Barbie and Skipper decide to raise funds for the destroyed library.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x1
episodes_data.description: Barbie, Tammy and all of Golden Beach High team up to defeat their rivals, Empire Coast High -- which tests Tammy's loyalties due to them being her old school.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x2
episodes_data.description: On Halloween, after watching a scary vampire movie, Chelsea believes that Barbie is a vampire along with her friends and try's to destroy them.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x3
episodes_data.description: When the Roberts go on a camping trip, Barbie makes brownies that no one can resist, but forbid anyone from eating them until the second night around the campfire, per family tradition. When someone eats the entire batch the night before though, the Roberts clan band together to figure out "whodunnit".

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x4
episodes_data.description: After the Roberts camper goes down and breaks, to get the money to replace it, Barbie and her sisters has to compete in game show that tears families down.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x5
episodes_data.description: Barbie feels horrible when outside commitments keep her from taking Chelsea to her first circus, so Barbie decides to make up for it by putting on a circus at the Dreamhouse.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x6
episodes_data.description: The Dudes & Trey get into a fight that results in the Dudes befriending Barbie instead. Without the Dudes, Trey finds a friend in Ken when they bond over a video game.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x7
episodes_data.description: To get attention of the school, Tammy decides to imitate Barbie. When it goes too far, Barbie begins to feel deprived of her individuality. Meanwhile, Trey is struggling to find a gift for his mother. Also, Stacie and Chelsea agree to babysit a fashionable macaw, and end up losing him. The macaw lands up at the Reardons' home, and Trey's mother loves him. How will the Robert sisters get him back?

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x8
episodes_data.description: Just before a chemistry project presentation, Barbie falls ill. However, she doesn't want to take a day off and tries to figure out some way to attend the presentation without letting her project partners down. Meanwhile, Trey fakes an illness to play hooky, but runs into trouble when the principal catches him out of school.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x9
episodes_data.description: Aunt Adele's inn is haunted by a ghost of a miner.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x10
episodes_data.description: With a new ice rink in town, Barbie and her friends put on a show to promote it. However, Nikki gets hurt before the show, and their only choice for a replacement is a mysterious yet skillful chicken-masked ice skater.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x11
episodes_data.description: Barbie and friends take the camper out to spend some quality time together.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x12
episodes_data.description: It's Christmastime at the Roberts House, but not all is holly jolly. Barbie and Ken can't find the perfect gift for each other for Christmas, Stacie and Skipper take drastic measures to get a good gift for each other, and the whole family has to prevent Chelsea from finding and opening the presents before Christmas morning.

episodes_data.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures 5x13
episodes_data.description: When Barbie, Teresa and Nikki are asked to write their school song, they learn a lesson in working out creative differences.
